headline: Early NHL trade board: What I'm hearing about 10 players to watch in 2026-27
take:
The Athletic's early trade board lists Dylan Larkin, along with Connor Hellebuyck, as a player whose NHL team (DET, in Larkin's case) is expected to move him this season. As Joe Yerdon of Bleacher Report posted, "You gotta think Dylan Larkin gets his wish soon," and Mike Fink of The Hockey News noted that Larkin has opened up his trade list.

A buyer would be getting a player whose process is better than his results so far this season. Larkin has one goal in nine games, but our numbers put his own expected goals (a measure of the quality of the chances he takes) at 2.46, so he is about one and a half goals short of what those chances normally produce. At 5-on-5, DET has taken 56 percent of the expected goals when he is on the ice, and the team's share is 3.6 points better with him out there. He is playing 21.5 minutes a night, and he scored 34 goals last season. Early scoring droughts like this tend to fix themselves, so we'd treat him as a buy-low candidate in fantasy leagues.
